name: Breeze Companion 0.3.1 — Seeds and delivery direction
notes:
Generating the same line in 0.3.0 reused seed 42 every time. Companion 0.3.1 randomizes browser generations by default and adds an optional delivery instruction for tone, emotion and pace.

### What changed

- **Seeds:** each generation displays the seed it used. Uncheck **Randomize each generation** to reuse it, or type a seed to turn randomization off automatically. The browser remembers both settings.
- **Delivery direction:** describe a performance such as “Speak softly, with a sad, hesitant tone.” Blank preserves the voice's usual delivery. Directions use the selected reference and adapter, retain curated accent instructions, and appear beside the result. Hold the seed fixed when comparing directions.
- **Vocal cues:** a short “Try (gasp) or (giggles) in your text” hint appears directly below the speech text box.
- **API:** both `/tts` and `/tts/stream` accept optional `seed` (integer 0–2147483647) and `direction` (up to 600 characters). Existing requests without these fields keep seed 42 and the curated voice settings. Responses report `X-Breeze-Seed`.

Directions steer the existing reference; there is no automatic emotion-based reference pool. Results vary by voice and model. Fixed seeds do not guarantee byte-identical GPU audio.

### Downloads

| Platform | Companion archive |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x86_64 | `breeze-tts-pny-0.3.1-windows-x86_64.zip` |
| Linux x86_64 | `breeze-tts-pny-server-0.3.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

New installations also need **`breeze-pny-curated-voices-20261115.tar.gz`**, attached below. Windows includes Python and the native runtime; Linux needs Python 3.11+ and the documented system dependencies. After setup, use `breeze-companion.cmd` on Windows or the installed `bin/breeze-pny serve --web` on Linux. The game is optional.

### Upgrade from 0.3.0

Stop the companion before updating. Reuse the existing voice archive: **game mod 0.1.3, the voice pack, models and patched 0.1.6 native runtime are unchanged**.

- **Windows:** copy the contents of the new extracted package into your existing package folder, preserving `companion/`, then run `setup.cmd --update`.
- **Linux:** from the new extracted folder, run `python3 installer/install.py --prefix /path/to/existing/installation --update`.

Setup preserves the selected model, ports and compatible personal references and reuses verified assets. Restart with your usual port overrides and open the newly printed session link. The page header should read **0.3.1**. [Complete upgrade guide](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.1/docs/COMPANION.md#upgrade-from-030). For 0.2.1 installations, follow the [earlier-version migration instructions](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.1/docs/COMPANION.md#upgrade-from-021).

### Validation

- 73 Python tests on Linux and under embedded Windows Python/Wine (five expected Windows skips), plus Chromium workflow checks, including seed persistence, direction, autoplay, cancellation, references, model controls and mobile layout.
- Real Q4 generation on an RX 6700 XT checked seed bounds, repeated seeds, and default/sad/angry directions for Spike, Pinkie and Octavia. These checks verify functional output, not emotional accuracy or voice similarity.
- Native Windows browser/GPU and game/VR testing remains with community testers. No new in-game or VR playtest is claimed.

See [validation details](https://github.com/ponywizard/breeze-tts-pny/blob/v0.3.1/docs/SERVER_VALIDATION.md). `SHA256SUMS`, build receipts and `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` identify the published artifacts and source commit.
